map.输入基本信息后得到 TDEE 与减脂/增肌目标区间。: Enter your basic information to get TDEE and target ranges for fat loss or muscle gain.
map.基础代谢率按 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式：男性 BMR = 10 ×: Basal metabolic rate follows the Mifflin-St Jeor formula: for men BMR = 10 × weight(kg) + 6.25 × height(cm) − 5 × age + 5; for women = 10 × weight + 6.25 × height − 5 × age − 161. Daily total expenditure TDEE = BMR × activity factor (bed rest 1.2, light 1.375, moderate 1.55, high 1.725, very high 1.9). The calorie deficit = TDEE − target intake, and a deficit of 7700 kcal roughly loses 1 kg of fat.
map.轻量活动（每周 1-3 次）: Light activity (1 to 3 times a week)
map.高强度（每周 6-7 次）: High intensity (6 to 7 times a week)
map.BMR 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式。: BMR uses the Mifflin-St Jeor formula.
map.TDEE 为基础代谢率 × 活动系数。: TDEE is the basal metabolic rate × the activity factor.
map.非医疗建议，减脂请确保每日至少留足基础营养。: Not medical advice. When cutting fat, always leave enough room for baseline nutrition.

map.女 55kg、162cm、30 岁、轻度活动：BMR = 10×55+6.25×: For a woman of 55 kg, 162 cm, age 30, light activity: BMR = 10×55+6.25×162−5×30−161 = 1222.5; TDEE = 1222.5×1.375 ≈ 1681 kcal; the recommended intake for fat loss is ≈ 1380 to 1480 kcal (a deficit of 200 to 300).
map.摄入低于 BMR（1222）长期损害代谢；一般女性不低于 1200、男性不低于: Intake below BMR (1222) harms metabolism over the long term; as a rule, women should stay above 1200 and men above 1500 kcal per day.
map.缺口设多少合适？: How Large Should the Deficit Be?
map.减脂常见 300–500 kcal/天缺口；过大易饿、掉肌肉、难坚持，小缺口更稳: A common deficit for fat loss is 300 to 500 kcal per day. Going larger causes hunger, muscle loss and difficulty sticking with it, while a smaller deficit is steadier.
map.为什么摄入不能低于 BMR？: Why Can't Intake Fall Below BMR?
map.BMR 是维持基本生命活动的最低耗能，长期低于它身体会降代谢、丢肌肉，不利健康减: BMR is the minimum energy needed to sustain basic life functions. Staying below it long term makes the body lower its metabolism and lose muscle, which works against healthy fat loss.
